name: opencrbasic
description: CRBasic language support for CR6 programs, backed by the opencrbasic language server.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Runs a Python language server from the configured interpreter. Trust this folder to enable CRBasic language support.

opencrbasic.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter that runs the opencrbasic language server. It needs the opencrbasic package and pygls (the lsp extra).

opencrbasic.serverArgs.description: Arguments passed to pythonPath to start the language server.

opencrbasic.serverEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the server process, for example PYTHONPATH pointing at a development checkout. These override inherited variables.

opencrbasic.entries.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns of entry programs. Each entry is analyzed with its includes.

opencrbasic.exclude.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns removed from the entries.

opencrbasic.logger.description: Logger profile used to analyze entry programs.

opencrbasic.encoding.description: Text encoding used to read unsaved document content and files.

opencrbasic.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds after the last edit before analysis starts.

opencrbasic.analysisTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for one analysis before it is abandoned.

opencrbasic.maxFileBytes.description: Files larger than this many bytes are not analyzed. The entries that read such a file report a warning instead of diagnostics.

opencrbasic.maxQueuedJobs.description: Maximum number of entry programs analyzed at once. The others wait and run as slots free; none is dropped.

opencrbasic.maxCacheMb.description: Memory in megabytes for parsed programs kept for hover, completion and navigation. The least recently used program is dropped when it is exceeded.

opencrbasic.checks.markdownDescription: Severity per opencrbasic check code, for example `{"OCB005": "off"}`. Overrides `opencrbasic.toml` (its `[checks]`, `[profile.*]` and `[entry.*]` tables). Checks run only on programs the reference compiler accepts.

opencrbasic.coverageNotices.description: Show coverage notices as hints: at the first use of a CR6 instruction, the reference compiler rules opencrbasic does not model. Information only, never a compiler verdict.

opencrbasic.helpDirectory.description: Directory holding the extracted CRBasic help (Instructions/*.htm and parameters/*.htm). A relative path is resolved against the first workspace folder. Empty: hover and signature help show no help text.

opencrbasic.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show the parameter name before each argument of an instruction or function call (for example Dest: before the first VoltSe argument). It needs helpDirectory: with no help text there are no hints.

opencrbasic.trace.server.description: Trace of client-server messages in the opencrbasic output channel.
